name: Adelaide University Whyalla City Council Student Grant
summary: $2,500 grant for first-time tertiary students from the Whyalla region studying full-time at the Whyalla campus.
key: Total $2,500, paid in two instalments of $1,250.
who: Enrolled full-time in an internal program at the Whyalla campus
Lived in the Whyalla region (postcodes 5600, 5601, 5608 or 5609) in Year 12 or the six months before applying
Never previously attended a tertiary institution
Financial need, such as a Health Care Card or means-tested Centrelink benefit
how: Apply online through myScholarships with a written statement of maximum 500 words
catches: 2026 applications opened 19 January and closed 29 March 2026; check for the next round

source.label: Adelaide University: Whyalla City Council Student Grant
